name: hexfront
description: HEXFRONT — prototype jouable en ligne (règles v0.1)

scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
